test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In January 2025, Wing Commander Akshay Saxena received the Vayu Sena Medal for his role in anti-piracy operations conducted in which of the following regions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arabian Sea**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Arabian Sea** is a part of the northern Indian Ocean, bounded by the Indian subcontinent on the east, the Arabian Peninsula on the west, and the Horn of Africa on the southwest.
 
• The region is a crucial route for **global maritime trade** and is often prone to **piracy activities**, especially near the Gulf of Aden and Somali waters.
 
• The Indian Navy plays a significant role in ensuring the **security of maritime trade routes** in this area, conducting regular **anti-piracy operations** to safeguard international shipping.
 
• **Wing Commander Akshay Saxena** played a pivotal role in these operations, contributing to the safety and security of maritime activities in the Arabian Sea.
 
• Due to its strategic importance, the Arabian Sea has been a focus area for **international naval coalitions** combating piracy and ensuring the free movement of trade.
 
• India's proactive role in anti-piracy operations in the Arabian Sea highlights its commitment to **global maritime security**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bay of Bengal**__

 __
 
• The **Bay of Bengal** is the northeastern part of the Indian Ocean, bordered by India and Sri Lanka to the west, Bangladesh to the north, and Myanmar and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands to the east.
 
• It is primarily known for its **cyclonic activities** and is less prone to piracy compared to the Arabian Sea.
 
• The region is significant for **fishing, shipping routes, and energy exploration**.
 
 
 
• **Gulf of Thailand**__
 __
 
• The **Gulf of Thailand** is situated in Southeast Asia, bordered by Thailand, Cambodia, and Vietnam.
 
• It is primarily known for its **tourism and fishing activities**, rather than piracy-related issues.
 
• The region supports major economies in Southeast Asia through its **marine resources**.
 
 
 
• **Andaman Sea**__
 
 
• The **Andaman Sea** lies to the southeast of the Bay of Bengal and is bordered by the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Myanmar, and Thailand.
 
• It is known for **marine biodiversity** and its role as a route for regional maritime trade.
 
• While piracy is rare in this region, it is monitored for **illegal fishing and smuggling activities**.
